sources.quote: HD 168592, also designated HR 6862 and named Magur, is a solitary star located in the southern constellation Corona Australis.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 372 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,044 K, so 39.341 solar radii.
